svg.aria-label: BioIntake architecture: two groups of users reach a Next.js front end and a FastAPI control API, both on AWS App Runner, which invoke a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore; a deterministic policy engine sits between the agent and DynamoDB, Amazon S3 and the LIMS, and alone authorises acceptance. Staff credentials come from AWS Secrets Manager and evidence requests go out through Amazon SES.
svg.text: Autonomous biospecimen intake. The agent can chase what is missing. Only the policy engine can accept a specimen.
